system.description: Magical dust. A ghost cannot cross a line of this dust without a Valor roll at difficulty 3; hungry ghosts cannot attempt without compulsion. Potency lasts one month, then difficulty drops by one per week. On the living: Damage 7L/day, Toxicity 4L, Tolerance —/—, Penalty -3. Kills create zombies (body) and hungry ghosts (soul). Illegal in the Realm. Potent for decades.
